name: Operations and workflow ledger
lineage: new — sequence allocation, claims, and settlement receipts (LLP 0133, LLP 0135) had no 0102 counterpart

scenarios.fact: Exact customers, jobs, steps, assignees, statuses, sequence numbers, activity, and personas exist.
scenarios.planBullet: customers, jobs, steps, assignees, status, sequence numbers, and activity

scenarios.fact: A human-visible sequence number is allocated transactionally, without gaps or duplicates under contention.
scenarios.planBullet: transactional allocation of a human-visible sequence

scenarios.fact: Child lists stay bounded and aggregate dashboard counts match the authoritative store.
scenarios.planBullet: bounded child lists and aggregate dashboard counts

scenarios.fact: A one-off transactional schedule and a recurring maintenance schedule both run with inspectable receipts.
scenarios.planBullet: one-off transactional scheduling and recurring maintenance

scenarios.fact: Claim, retry, timeout, and cancellation each leave append-only attempt receipts.
scenarios.planBullet: claim, retry, timeout, cancellation, and append-only attempt receipts

scenarios.fact: External dispatch is idempotent with inspectable settlement.
scenarios.planBullet: idempotent external dispatch with inspectable settlement

scenarios.fact: Concurrent claims resolve to one owner and ownership fencing rejects the loser's late writes.
The operational dashboard updates live with range filters through the attributed path.
scenarios.planBullet: live operational dashboard with range filters

scenarios.fact: Export and restore round-trip the ledger with verified counts.
Only exact fresh targets or the arm-owned namespace are cleaned up; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
